description: Detects insecure defaults, overly permissive CORS, exposed debug endpoints, and missing security headers. Use when writing server configuration, setting environment variables, configuring CORS policies, enabling debug modes, setting up default credentials, or deploying application infrastructure. Also invoke when writing security headers middleware.
